ideas.title: Investigating the Use of Force by Federal Agents in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti and the subsequent immigration crackdown in Minnesota, with a focus on the use of force by federal agents.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding Alex Pretti's shooting?
What is the policy on use of force by federal agents in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover systemic issues with the use of force by federal agents and to hold those responsible accountable. It requires careful investigation and analysis of the facts surrounding the shooting and the subsequent crackdown.
